items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer and Kent Jordan responding politely. No personal or professional relationship is described.

ctx.x: Kent was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 22, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Rome, New York with Kent Jordan. Thanks for being here.
I’m glad to be here. This is an honor and a privilege, it really is.
